properties.permit_en: New South Wales: no general licence, but landholder consent needed. In state forests a fossicking permit from Forestry Corporation (12 months, about A$27.50). Forbidden in national parks (incl. Hill End Historic Site).

properties.en: Historic gold valley in southern NSW.
properties.find_de: Flitter und kleine Nuggets in den alten Goldfeldern am Turon und um Hill End.
properties.find_en: Flakes and small nuggets in the old goldfields on the Turon and around Hill End.
properties.permit_de: New South Wales: keine allgemeine Lizenz, aber Zustimmung des Landbesitzers nötig. In State Forests ein Fossicking Permit der Forestry Corporation (12 Monate, ca. A$27.50). In Nationalparks verboten (auch Hill End Historic Site).
properties.permit_en: New South Wales: no general licence, but landholder consent needed. In state forests a fossicking permit from Forestry Corporation (12 months, about A$27.50). Forbidden in national parks (incl. Hill End Historic Site).

properties.name: Tennant Creek / Warrego Fossicking Area
properties.de: Bekanntestes Goldgebiet im Northern Territory; Warrego Fossicking Area in der Nähe.
properties.en: Best-known gold area in the Northern Territory; Warrego Fossicking Area nearby.
properties.find_de: Nuggets um Tennant Creek, sehr abgelegen.
properties.find_en: Nuggets around Tennant Creek, very remote.
properties.permit_de: Northern Territory: Fossicking Permit nötig (Quellen widersprechen sich, ob er überall gilt); in ausgewiesenen Fossicking Areas wie Warrego einfacher. Aboriginal Land nur mit Erlaubnis.
properties.permit_en: Northern Territory: fossicking permit required (sources disagree whether everywhere); easier in declared fossicking areas such as Warrego. Aboriginal land only with permission.

properties.en: South Australia's first goldfield (1852).

properties.permit_de: South Australia: Hobby-Fossicking ohne Verkaufsabsicht braucht meist keine Erlaubnis; Landbesitzer fragen, Parks gesperrt.
properties.permit_en: South Australia: hobby fossicking without intent to sell usually needs no permit; ask the landholder, parks are closed.

properties.permit_en: Tasmania: no licence inside the declared fossicking areas; elsewhere a prospecting licence from Mineral Resources Tasmania.
